title: AI Pedagogical Assistant
subtitle: Dedicated tutor specialized in Cloud AI architectures, exam trap analysis, and mnemonics.
inputPlaceholder: Ask a question about a concept, architecture, or exam trap...
suggestedPrompts: Explain the difference between RAG and Fine-Tuning
How does the SM-2 SRS spaced repetition algorithm work?
What are common pitfalls on the AI-102 exam?
Which ML metrics should I memorize for the GCP exam?
methodologyDesc: For each concept: read the theoretical explanation, identify exam pitfalls, then test your retention with SM-2 Flashcards.
pillar1: Standard Architecture: Use a tailored modular approach without overprovisioning compute infrastructure.
pillar2: Security & Compliance: Encryption in transit and at rest (Customer-Managed Keys), GDPR/HIPAA compliance, and VNet isolation.
pillar3: Observability: Logging inference traces, calculating latency P99, and monitoring prompt drift.
goldenRuleText: Never choose a complex custom solution if a native provider managed service satisfies the requirement with less code.
trap1Title: Pitfall #1: Choosing between RAG and Fine-Tuning
trap1Text: The exam often presents a case where internal documents update weekly. Trap answer: fine-tune the model weekly (costly, catastrophic forgetting risk). Correct answer: RAG vector indexing with Semantic Ranker.
trap2Text: Built-in moderation filters do not automatically block your enterprise proprietary data without configuring a Custom Blocklist.
